name: Profile button displays the user initial at the top-left corner of the Dashboard after login
objective: Verifies AC-1, AC-8: Profile button displays the user initial at the top-left corner of the Dashboard after login
precondition: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/

testSteps.description: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
testSteps.expectedResult: the Dashboard page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user views the top-left corner of the Dashboard
testSteps.expectedResult: the profile button displaying the single uppercase character 'B' is visible at the top-left corner

name: Clicking the profile button opens the user menu with all required elements
objective: Verifies AC-2, AC-10: Clicking the profile button opens the user menu with all required elements
precondition: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/

testSteps.description: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
testSteps.expectedResult: the Dashboard page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user clicks the profile button at the top-left corner
testSteps.expectedResult: the user menu is displayed containing the user initial, the email address {{validEmail}}, a Profile button, and a Logout button as distinct visible elements

name: Clicking Logout in the user menu displays the native browser confirmation popup with correct text
objective: Verifies AC-3, AC-4, AC-11, AC-12, AC-13, BR-2: Clicking Logout in the user menu displays the native browser confirmation popup with correct text
precondition: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/

testSteps.description: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
testSteps.expectedResult: the Dashboard page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user clicks the profile button and then clicks the Logout button in the user menu
testSteps.expectedResult:
a native browser dialog is displayed with header text 'Log out?' and body text 'Are you sure you want to log out? Any unsaved changes will be lost.'
the dialog contains a Cancel button and a Logout button

name: Clicking Logout in the confirmation popup terminates the session and redirects to the Login page
objective: Verifies AC-6, AC-14, BR-3: Clicking Logout in the confirmation popup terminates the session and redirects to the Login page
precondition: the authenticated user has clicked Logout in the user menu and the confirmation popup is displayed

testSteps.description: the authenticated user has clicked Logout in the user menu and the confirmation popup is displayed
testSteps.expectedResult: the native browser confirmation dialog is displayed

testSteps.description: the user clicks the Logout button in the confirmation popup
testSteps.expectedResult:
the session is terminated and the user is redirected to the Login page at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
the Dashboard is no longer accessible

name: Clicking Cancel on the confirmation popup closes it and keeps the user authenticated on the Dashboard
objective: Verifies AC-5, AC-15, BR-3: Clicking Cancel on the confirmation popup closes it and keeps the user authenticated on the Dashboard
precondition: the authenticated user has clicked Logout in the user menu and the confirmation popup is displayed

testSteps.description: the authenticated user has clicked Logout in the user menu and the confirmation popup is displayed
testSteps.expectedResult: the native browser confirmation dialog is displayed

testSteps.description: the user clicks the Cancel button in the confirmation popup
testSteps.expectedResult:
the confirmation popup is closed and the user remains on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
the user remains authenticated with no session change

name: Navigating to the Dashboard URL after logout displays the Login page instead of the Dashboard
objective: Verifies AC-7, BR-3: Navigating to the Dashboard URL after logout displays the Login page instead of the Dashboard
precondition: the user has completed the logout flow and is on the Login page at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/

testSteps.description: the user has completed the logout flow and is on the Login page at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
testSteps.expectedResult: the Login page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user navigates to https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
testSteps.expectedResult: the Login page is displayed and the Dashboard is not accessible

name: Attempting to reuse a terminated session to access the Dashboard is blocked
objective: Verifies AC-14, BR-3: Attempting to reuse a terminated session to access the Dashboard is blocked
precondition: the user has completed the logout flow and the session has been terminated

testSteps.description: the user has completed the logout flow and the session has been terminated
testSteps.expectedResult: the Login page at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/ is displayed

testSteps.description: the user attempts to access the Dashboard by navigating to https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
testSteps.expectedResult: the Login page is displayed instead of the Dashboard, confirming the terminated session cannot be reused

name: Hovering over the profile button displays the user email as a native browser tooltip
objective: Verifies AC-9: Hovering over the profile button displays the user email as a native browser tooltip
precondition: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/

testSteps.description: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
testSteps.expectedResult: the Dashboard page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user hovers over the profile button at the top-left corner
testSteps.expectedResult: a native browser tooltip displaying {{validEmail}} is shown

name: Profile button displays exactly the single uppercase character 'B' derived from {{validEmail}}
objective: Verifies AC-1, AC-8: Profile button displays exactly the single uppercase character 'B' derived from {{validEmail}}
precondition: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/

testSteps.description: the authenticated user is on the Dashboard at https://admin.nexolvi.ai/
testSteps.expectedResult: the Dashboard page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user views the profile button at the top-left corner
testSteps.expectedResult: the profile button displays exactly the single uppercase character 'B' and no other characters

name: Reopening the user menu after cancelling the logout popup shows the menu again without session change
objective: Verifies AC-5, AC-15, BR-3: Reopening the user menu after cancelling the logout popup shows the menu again without session change
precondition: the authenticated user has clicked Cancel on the logout confirmation popup and is back on the Dashboard

testSteps.description: the authenticated user has clicked Cancel on the logout confirmation popup and is back on the Dashboard
testSteps.expectedResult: the Dashboard is displayed and the user is authenticated

testSteps.description: the user clicks the profile button again
testSteps.expectedResult: the user menu is displayed again containing the user initial, the email address {{validEmail}}, a Profile button, and a Logout button
